description: Prepares (does not send) an unsigned Solana transaction that swaps USDC for a tokenized-treasury token (e.g. USDY) via Jupiter. Returns the base64 versioned transaction and a sign link. Nothing is executed: the user reviews and signs it in their own wallet.
name: build_deposit_yield_tx

error.description: Why the transaction could not be prepared

ok.description: false when the transaction could not be prepared (see error)

signId.description: Id of the prepared, unsigned transaction

signUrl.description: Page where the user reviews and signs in their own wallet (null in local stdio mode)

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 versioned Solana transaction plus lastValidBlockHeight
